<parameter name="content">from enum import Enum


class OrderState(Enum):
    CREATED = "created"
    PAID = "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"


class InvalidTransition(Exception):
    pass


class Order:
    # ponytail: explicit transition table, add guards (e.g. inventory checks) at callers
    TRANSITIONS = {
        OrderState.CREATED: {OrderState.PAID, OrderState.CANCELLED},
        OrderState.PAID: {OrderState.SHIPPED, OrderState.REFUNDED},
        OrderState.SHIPPED: {OrderState.DELIVERED, OrderState.CANCELLED},
        OrderState.DELIVERED: {OrderState.REFUNDED},
        OrderState.CANCELLED: set(),
        OrderState.REFUNDED: set(),
    }

    def __init__(self, order_id: str):
        self.order_id = order_id
        self.state = OrderState.CREATED

    def transition(self, new_state: OrderState) -> None:
        if new_state not in self.TRANSITIONS[self.state]:
            raise InvalidTransition(
                f"Cannot transition from {self.state.value} to {new_state.value}"
            )
        self.state = new_state

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"Order({self.order_id}, {self.state.value})"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    order = Order("ORD-001")
    print(f"Initial: {order}")

    order.transition(OrderState.PAID)
    print(f"After payment: {order}")

    order.transition(OrderState.SHIPPED)
    print(f"After shipping: {order}")

    order.transition(OrderState.DELIVERED)
    print(f"After delivery: {order}")

    order.transition(OrderState.REFUNDED)
    print(f"After refund: {order}")

    print("\n--- Testing invalid transition ---")
    order2 = Order("ORD-002")
    try:
        order2.transition(OrderState.SHIPPED)
    except InvalidTransition as e:
        print(f"Caught: {e}")

    print("\n--- Testing cancelled path ---")
    order3 = Order("ORD-003")
    order3.transition(OrderState.CANCELLED)
    print(f"Cancelled: {order3}")

    try:
        order3.transition(OrderState.PAID)
    except InvalidTransition as e:
        print(f"Caught: {e}")
